For |n|<=F_(k-4), lower bounds exclude all but prefix (1,0,-1) for positive n and its sign reverse for negative; f(0;k)=0. Substituting d_j=1+eps_j on remaining k−3 slots transforms n=F_(k−1)+sum eps_jF_j into n=1+sum d_jF_j bijectively; F1=F2=1 are distinct labeled slots. Larger product factors exceed n−1, proving exact stable coefficient identity over all n. Summing products counts finite vectors, with 3^(J−4)<=T(X)<=3^J when F_J<=X−1<F_(J+1), and Binet yields exponent log3/log(phi). Independently computed signed counts and product coefficients for k=5..21 and all prescribed boundary n; checked exact count and both directions, no finite-to-infinite extrapolation.
